::: {#exm-forward-process}

#### A noise schedule

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
n_steps = 100
betas = torch.linspace(1e-4, 0.1, n_steps)
alpha_bars = torch.cumprod(1 - betas, dim=0)
print(alpha_bars[[9, 49, 99]])
```

With $T = `r py$n_steps`$ steps and $\beta_t$ rising evenly from 0.0001 to 0.1,
$\bar\alpha_t$ is `r sprintf("%.2f", py$alpha_bars$tolist()[[10]])` after 10 steps,
`r sprintf("%.3f", py$alpha_bars$tolist()[[50]])` after 50
and `r sprintf("%.4f", py$alpha_bars$tolist()[[100]])` after 100.
@ho2020denoising [section 4] use $T = 1000$ steps,
with $\beta_t$ from 0.0001 to 0.02.

:::
